note: Ryan 负责试炼，篝火学徒/行家在旁边起哄；两人重复的台词只收一份。Wiki 的 Ryan 页面用 <tier>/<amount> 说明变量，具体字句与颜色以实测为准。三个角色的对话都保持轻松口语，不能把 10 秒和伤害门槛写丢。

messages.context: 篝火旁学徒/行家谈到 Ryan 的烤棉花糖承诺
messages.text: Hey I'm just here cause Ryan promised marshmallows.
messages.zh: 我来这儿就是因为 Ryan 答应给烤棉花糖。

messages.context: 篝火旁学徒/行家开玩笑
messages.text: Some call us the campfire cult!
messages.zh: 有人管我们叫篝火教团呢!

messages.context: 篝火旁学徒/行家邀请玩家挑战
messages.text: Prove yourself in the Trials of Fire!
messages.zh: 去烈焰试炼证明一下自己吧!

messages.context: Ryan 告知下一关的真实伤害门槛
messages.raw: Next step is the §6Trial of Fire XXIII§f! §7(260,100 damage)
messages.text: Next step is the Trial of Fire %1$s! (%2$s damage)
messages.zh: 下一关是烈焰试炼 %1$s! (承受 %2$s 点伤害)

messages.context: Ryan 说明进入篝火并存活十秒
messages.raw: Step into the campfire to start the trial and survive for §610s§f!
messages.text: Step into the campfire to start the trial and survive for %ss!
messages.zh: 走进篝火就能开始试炼，撑过 %s 秒!

segments.text: Step into the campfire to start the trial and survive for
segments.zh: 走进篝火就能开始试炼，撑过

messages.context: Ryan 告知篝火神徽章前后等级
messages.raw: §aYour §6Campfire God Badge I §ahas been upgraded to a §6Campfire God Badge II§a!
messages.text: Your Campfire God Badge %1$s has been upgraded to a Campfire God Badge %2$s!
messages.zh: 你的篝火神徽章已从 %1$s 级升级至 %2$s 级!

messages.context: Ryan 邀请挑战下一级，实测英语重复 Trial
messages.raw: Try the §6Trial of Fire Trial XXIV §ffor a greater challenge!
messages.text: Try the Trial of Fire Trial %s for a greater challenge!
messages.zh: 想挑战更难的? 来试试烈焰试炼 %s!

segments.zh: 想挑战更难的? 来试试

messages.context: Ryan 提醒继续完成试炼升级饰品
messages.raw: Keep completing trials to upgrade your accessory!
messages.text: Keep completing trials to upgrade your accessory!
messages.zh: 继续闯关，你的饰品还能再升级!
